low.title: Full-Day Vukovar Nightlife on a Low Budget
low.summary: A full day ending with a fun, budget-friendly evening — river lights, music, promenades, and affordable local food.

schedule.title: Danube River Warm-Up Walk
schedule.description: Start with fresh air, morning reflections on the river, and chill vibes.

schedule.title: Old Town Exploration
schedule.description: Walk through historical streets and get familiar with the city layout for later tonight.

schedule.title: Budget Local Lunch
schedule.description: Enjoy affordable traditional dishes — stews, soups, grilled options.

schedule.title: Afternoon Break at the Promenade
schedule.description: Sit in the shade, relax, and save energy for the evening.

schedule.title: Riverside Chill Time
schedule.description: A calm pre-evening walk with plenty of great photo spots.

schedule.title: Sunset Over the Danube
schedule.description: Golden hour reflections set the tone for your nightlife portion.

schedule.title: Nightlife on a Budget
schedule.description: Walk the lit-up promenade, enjoy music from open public spaces, grab cheap ice cream or snacks, and soak in the evening atmosphere.

medium.title: Balanced Full-Day + Evening Vukovar Nightlife
medium.summary: A comfortable day ending with a lively, enjoyable night around Vukovar’s riverside and town center.

schedule.title: Café Morning Start
schedule.description: A relaxed coffee or tea to begin your balanced day.

schedule.title: City Walk & Landmarks
schedule.description: Explore Vukovar’s known spots — perfect for orientation at night.

schedule.title: Medium Local Lunch
schedule.description: A hearty traditional meal at a reasonable price.

schedule.title: Promenade Chill Zone
schedule.description: Relax near the river, listen to the water, enjoy nature.

schedule.title: Light Afternoon Activity
schedule.description: Stroll small parks or check out souvenir shops.

schedule.title: Sunset + Photo Time
schedule.description: Capture the beautiful colors over the Danube.

schedule.title: Balanced Nightlife
schedule.description: Walk the illuminated promenade, enjoy live public music if available, stop for dessert, and experience Vukovar’s calm night energy.

high.title: High-End Full-Day Experience Ending with Evening Lights
high.summary: A polished day route that ends with a premium, scenic evening walking experience full of lights, scenery, and atmosphere.

schedule.title: Premium Breakfast by the River
schedule.description: Start with a higher-quality breakfast with a view.

schedule.title: Town Discovery Walk
schedule.description: A calm walk through elegant streets, preparing for the nighttime atmosphere.

schedule.title: High-Quality Local Lunch
schedule.description: Enjoy refined versions of traditional meals.

schedule.title: Scenic Afternoon Walk
schedule.description: Visit clean, curated riverside segments with great ambience.

schedule.title: Manor/Park Blend
schedule.description: Visit elegant outdoor areas that look stunning at dusk.

schedule.title: Golden-Hour Danube View
schedule.description: Perfect light sets the mood for a classy evening.

schedule.title: Premium Night Atmosphere Walk
schedule.description: Walk carefully illuminated riverside segments with calm music, reflections on the water, and premium nighttime views.

comfortable.title: Luxury Full-Day + Premium Evening Lights
comfortable.summary: A luxurious full-day experience leading into Vukovar’s most beautiful nighttime spots, perfect for photos and calm evening enjoyment.

schedule.title: Lux Breakfast with Danube View
schedule.description: Start your day in an elegant café with a beautifully prepared meal.

schedule.title: Curated Heritage Walk
schedule.description: Visit the most elegant parts of Vukovar’s center.

schedule.title: Fine Local Lunch
schedule.description: High-end dishes inspired by regional flavors.

schedule.title: Premium Promenade Rest
schedule.description: Find calm, polished riverside segments perfect for relaxing.

schedule.title: Elegant Afternoon Walk
schedule.description: Stroll through green zones and scenic paths.

schedule.title: Sunset Glow
schedule.description: Capture the most photogenic sunset of the day.

schedule.title: Luxury Night Walk
schedule.description: Explore beautifully lit areas, enjoy fountains, river reflections, artistic lighting, and relaxing evening ambiance — teen-friendly and classy.
